cohort: 901 pregnant women in Norway; 174 pregnant after stillbirth, 362 pregnant after live birth, and 365 nulliparous
finding: Women pregnant after stillbirth had more frequent antenatal visits, induced labor, and cesarean sections (both elective and emergency) compared to women with a previous live birth or nulliparous women.
mod_finding: Elective cesarean section was more prevalent in the stillbirth group, with an adjusted odds ratio of 2.5 (95% CI 1.3-5.0) compared with women with previous live birth and 3.7 (1.8-7.6) compared with previously nulliparous women.
